items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Rosalind Research for trusted life-sciences access
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Rosalind Research 供可信賴生命科學使用
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s October 30 system-card addendum and Business release notes introduce GPT-6 Rosalind Research (API id gpt-6-rosalind), a biology/drug-discovery configuration that reuses GPT-6 Astra weights with no additional training and adjusted refusal behavior for institutional life-sciences partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10月30日系統卡附錄與 Business 發行說明推出 GPT-6 Rosalind Research（API id gpt-6-rosalind），此為生命科學／藥物發現配置，重用 GPT-6 Astra 權重、無額外訓練，並調整拒絕行為以供機構生命科學合作夥伴使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a refusal-and-access product on existing weights rather than a newly trained model, letting OpenAI serve dual-use biology research under institutional controls while charging for controlled access.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是在既有權重上的拒絕與存取產品，而非新訓練模型，讓 OpenAI 能在機構控管下提供雙重用途生物學研究，同時對受控存取收費。
items_flat.quote: GPT-Rosalind-6 uses the same weights as GPT-6 Astra. We did not add training data or perform additional post-training for this release.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-Rosalind-6 使用與 GPT-6 Astra 相同的權重。我們並未為此版本新增訓練資料或進行額外的後訓練。

links.label: OpenAI Business release notes / system-card addendum
OpenAI Help Center Model Release Notes

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 釋出約1兆參數 Large 4 開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a multimodal MoE model with roughly 1 trillion total parameters (about 52 billion active), on or around October 29 under its ecosystem open-weight license on Hugging Face. The company also offers it via its API and partners, highlighting coding-agent and cybersecurity use cases after additional reinforcement learning.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 於約10月29日在 Hugging Face 以生態系統開源權重授權釋出 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的權重，這是約1兆總參數（約520億活躍）的多模態 MoE 模型。公司亦透過自有 API 與合作夥伴提供，並強調經額外強化學習後的程式代理與網路安全用途。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the largest recent open-weight frontier-class release, improving access for organizations that prefer self-hosting. Reported benchmark gains are company-sourced and still trail the strongest closed models on several agentic coding tests.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是近期最大的開源權重前沿級釋出，提升偏好自託管組織的存取能力。報告的基準提升來自公司來源，在多項代理程式測試上仍落後最強封閉模型。
items_flat.quote: We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們釋出 Le Chonk 的權重，推動開源模型在代理式編碼與網路安全上的前沿。

links.label: Coverage of Mistral Large 4 open-weights release

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI to share ChatGPT and Codex usage allowance from December for Plus, Pro and Business
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 自十二月起將 Plus、Pro、Business 的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 使用額度合併
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s help-center article, updated around October 31, states that starting in December Plus, Pro and Business plans will draw from one shared token-based allowance across ChatGPT and Codex as agentic Work capabilities move into the main ChatGPT experience. Instant chat will not consume the allowance; remaining usage and reset times will appear in Settings → Usage, with credits available after the limit.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 幫助中心文章（約10月31日更新）指出，自十二月起 Plus、Pro、Business 方案的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 將共用單一以 token 計算的額度，因 Work 的代理功能將整合進主要 ChatGPT 體驗。Instant 聊天不計入額度；使用者可在設定→使用量查看剩餘額度與重設時間，達到上限後可購買點數。
items_flat.analysis_en: This unifies agentic and chat consumption under one meter, so heavy Codex or Work sessions can reduce remaining capacity for other advanced ChatGPT tasks; the lack of published per-plan token totals or exact start date leaves users without a clear budget until the switch occurs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將代理與聊天使用量統一為單一計量，重度 Codex 或 Work 工作會直接減少其他進階 ChatGPT 任務的剩餘額度；目前未公布各方案具體 token 總量與確切生效日，使用者在切換前難以精確預算。
items_flat.quote: Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans’ usage allowance will be shared across ChatGPT and Codex as we bring the agentic capabilities of Work into the main ChatGPT experience.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自十二月起，Plus、Pro 與 Business 方案的使用額度將在 ChatGPT 與 Codex 之間共享，因為我們將把 Work 的代理能力帶入主要 ChatGPT 體驗。

links.label: OpenAI Help Center – Understanding ChatGPT and Codex usage limits

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI will honor shared robots.txt signal for AI-training preferences
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將支援共享 robots.txt AI 訓練偏好訊號
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s October 30 blog post announces it will honor a common robots.txt signal (tied to the IETF AI Preferences work) so website operators can express one preference about foundational generative AI training to multiple participating providers. Implementation is targeted for the coming months; existing crawler controls remain in force and the signal does not replace them.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10月30日部落格宣布將遵守共通的 robots.txt 訊號（與 IETF AI 偏好工作相關），讓網站營運者能一次向多個參與供應商表達基礎生成式 AI 訓練的偏好。實施目標為未來數月；既有爬蟲控制仍持續有效，新訊號不會取代它們。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move reduces per-provider rules for publishers but remains voluntary and phased; actual enforcement depends on when each lab finishes implementation and on the still-draft status of the underlying signal.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉降低出版商需為各供應商分別設定規則的負擔，但仍屬自願且分階段；實際執行取決於各實驗室完成實作的時間，以及底層訊號仍屬草案的狀態。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing that OpenAI will honor a common signal in robots.txt... We aim to implement the signal in the coming months... This new signal will not replace the controls we already provide through robots.txt.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 OpenAI 將遵守 robots.txt 中的共通訊號……我們目標在未來數月內實作該訊號……此新訊號不會取代我們已透過 robots.txt 提供的控制。

links.label: OpenAI Blog – Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences

items_flat.title_en: Musk details Colossus 2 expansion with Gun Range and Spam halls targeting ~1.2M Blackwells
items_flat.title_zh: Musk 詳述 Colossus 2 擴建，新增 Gun Range 與 Spam 大廳，目標年底約120萬 Blackwell
items_flat.summary_en: In X posts on October 31, Elon Musk stated that Macroharder and Minihard each hold 220,000 Nvidia GB300s for training; a former police gun range (“Gun Range”) will match that setup and is tracking for end-of-November operation, while a former Hormel building (“Spam”) will hold ~200,000 GB300s for inference in December. He said the campus is expected to reach around 1.2 million Blackwells by year-end.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 10月31日在 X 發文指出，Macroharder 與 Minihard 各有 22 萬顆 Nvidia GB300 用於訓練；前警察局靶場（Gun Range）將配置相同規模並目標於十一月底運作，前 Hormel 建築（Spam）則將於十二月配置約 20 萬顆 GB300 用於推理。他表示園區年底預計達約 120 萬顆 Blackwell。
items_flat.analysis_en: The figures are Musk’s own targets rather than independently verified inventory; they expand the power and permitting footprint already under legal challenge while accelerating the compute ramp for Grok training and inference.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些數字為 Musk 個人目標而非獨立驗證的庫存；它們擴大了已面臨法律挑戰的電力與許可足跡，同時加速 Grok 訓練與推理的算力擴張。
items_flat.quote: Gun Range is tracking to be operational by end of November and Spam in December. ... the campus would have around 1.2 million Blackwells by year-end.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gun Range 目標於十一月底運作，Spam 則在十二月。……園區年底預計有約 120 萬顆 Blackwell。

links.label: Elon Musk on X (via contemporaneous reports)

items_flat.title_en: Google receives first AI response from Project Suncatcher prototype satellite TPU
items_flat.title_zh: Google 從 Project Suncatcher 原型衛星 TPU 收到首次 AI 回應
items_flat.summary_en: Google Research’s October 30 post reports that the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite, launched October 1, completed commissioning and returned its first AI output from a data-center-class TPU in orbit. An onboard Gemma 4 model generated a haiku about being in space during a ground-station pass over Svalbard; further thermal and radiation tests are planned ahead of twin-satellite work in 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Research 10月30日貼文指出，10月1日發射的 Project Suncatcher 原型衛星已完成調校，並從軌道上的資料中心級 TPU 傳回首次 AI 輸出。 onboard 的 Gemma 4 模型在經過斯瓦爾巴地面站時生成了一首關於在太空的俳句；後續將進行熱與輻射測試，為 2027 年雙衛星工作鋪路。
items_flat.analysis_en: The milestone confirms basic on-orbit TPU inference is possible but does not yet demonstrate scalable orbital compute; radiation hardness, power, thermal control and inter-satellite networking remain open engineering questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此里程碑確認軌道上基本 TPU 推理可行，但尚未展示可擴展的軌道計算；輻射耐受、電力、熱控與衛星間網路仍是開放的工程問題。
items_flat.quote: This week, we reached our "Hello World" milestone: the first-ever AI response from a data center class TPU in orbit.
items_flat.quote_zh: 本週，我們達到了「Hello World」里程碑：軌道上資料中心級 TPU 首次傳回 AI 回應。

links.label: Google Blog – Project Suncatcher satellite response

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic renames Max 20x to Ultra and removes five-hour limit for verified accounts
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Max 20x 更名為 Ultra，並為驗證帳號移除五小時限制
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s help center documents and an October 30 X post state that the $200 Max 20x plan is now called Ultra, with prices unchanged. Verified Ultra accounts no longer face the rolling five-hour usage cap; weekly limits (10× Pro) and other controls remain.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 幫助中心文件與10月30日 X 貼文指出，$200 的 Max 20x 方案現更名為 Ultra，價格不變。已驗證的 Ultra 帳號不再受滾動五小時使用上限限制；每週上限（10× Pro）與其他控制仍保留。
items_flat.analysis_en: Removing the short-cycle cap on the top consumer plan reduces friction for heavy Claude Code users without increasing total weekly allowance, while the verification step adds a light identity gate.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 移除頂層消費方案的短週期上限，降低重度 Claude Code 使用者的摩擦，但未增加總每週額度；驗證步驟則增加輕量身份門檻。
items_flat.quote: We're also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們也為已驗證的 Ultra 帳戶移除5小時限制，今天起從大多數現有訂閱者開始。

links.label: Anthropic on X (Max to Ultra rename)
Claude Help Center: What is the Ultra plan?

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind expands Gemini-powered PlanAssist to 12 more UK councils
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 將 Gemini 驅動的 PlanAssist 擴展至額外12個英國議會
items_flat.summary_en: DeepMind’s October 31 blog post states that PlanAssist, built with Gemini, is moving from three pilot councils into a 12-month beta with 12 additional English local authorities (15 total). Early pilots cut householder application assessment times while retaining human oversight.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepMind 10月31日部落格指出，以 Gemini 打造的 PlanAssist 正從三個試點議會進入12個月測試，新增12個英格蘭地方當局（共15個）。早期試點縮短了戶主申請評估時間，同時保留人工監督。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a practical government-deployment story rather than a model release, showing Gemini applied to high-volume administrative work with human oversight retained. The reported time savings are pilot-specific and not yet independently audited at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是實用的政府部署故事而非模型釋出，顯示 Gemini 應用於高量行政工作並保留人工監督。報告的時間節省為試點特定，尚未大規模獨立稽核。
items_flat.quote: PlanAssist has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%.
items_flat.quote_zh: PlanAssist 已顯示能將規劃官員評估屋主申請的時間最多減少58%。

items_flat.title_en: xAI/SpaceXSI to enable default invisible text watermarks on Grok API from November 7
items_flat.title_zh: xAI/SpaceXSI 自11月7日起對 Grok API 預設啟用不可見文字浮水印
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXSI developer documentation states that starting November 7, 2026, text outputs from grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-4.3 and three grok-4.20 variants will carry an invisible statistical watermark by default on both Responses and Chat Completions endpoints.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXSI 開發者文件指出，自2026年11月7日起，grok-4.7、grok-4.6、grok-4.5、grok-4.3 及三個 grok-4.20 變體的文字輸出將在 Responses 與 Chat Completions 端點預設帶有不可見統計浮水印。
items_flat.analysis_en: The watermark is a compliance mechanism that slightly shapes token selection without adding visible characters or changing length/speed claims. It affects API customers only for now and does not alter consumer Grok surfaces.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 浮水印是合規機制，輕微影響 token 選擇，但不增加可見字元或改變長度／速度宣稱。目前僅影響 API 客戶，不改變消費者 Grok 介面。
items_flat.quote: Starting November 7, 2026, responses from these models include a watermark. It's on by default, and you can opt out per model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自2026年11月7日起，這些模型的回應將包含浮水印。預設開啟，您可按模型退出。

links.label: SpaceXSI / xAI Developer Docs – Output Watermarking

items_flat.title_en: Judge denies xAI motion to dismiss NAACP Clean Air Act suit over Southaven turbines
items_flat.title_zh: 法官駁回 xAI 請求駁回 NAACP 針對 Southaven 渦輪機的清潔空氣法訴訟
items_flat.summary_en: On or around October 30, U.S. District Judge Debra M. Brown denied xAI’s motion to dismiss the NAACP’s Clean Air Act lawsuit concerning gas turbines powering the Colossus data center in Southaven, Mississippi. The court found the turbines are subject to permitting requirements and allowed the claims to proceed.
items_flat.summary_zh: 約10月30日，美國地區法官 Debra M. Brown 駁回 xAI 請求駁回 NAACP 針對密西西比 Southaven Colossus 資料中心燃氣渦輪機的清潔空氣法訴訟。法院認定渦輪機受許可要求拘束，並允許訴訟繼續。
items_flat.analysis_en: The ruling keeps the permitting and emissions claims alive but does not decide liability. It is an operational and regulatory risk story for xAI’s power infrastructure rather than a model or product announcement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 裁決讓許可與排放主張繼續進行，但未裁定責任。這是 xAI 電力基礎設施的營運與監管風險故事，而非模型或產品公告。
items_flat.quote: Because the Plant is not a ‘mobile source’ according to the federal regulations…the Plant was not (and is not) exempted from permitting requirements under the Clean Air Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 根據聯邦法規，該廠並非『移動來源』……該廠過去（及現在）並未豁免清潔空氣法下的許可要求。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic updates usage policy to ban sustained needless abuse of Claude
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策，禁止對 Claude 持續無謂虐待
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s October 8 usage-policy update (effective November 12) adds a prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward its models. The company states the rule applies only to extreme, purposeless cases and does not cover ordinary frustration, criticism, dark creative themes, or model research; ending the conversation remains the primary enforcement mechanism.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 10月8日的使用政策更新（11月12日生效）新增禁止對其模型進行持續且無謂的虐待或殘忍行為。公司表示該規則僅適用於極端、無目的的情況，不涵蓋一般挫折、批評、黑暗創作主題或模型研究；結束對話仍是主要執行機制。
items_flat.analysis_en: The formalization extends earlier model-welfare experiments but leaves the boundary between “needless cruelty” and legitimate stress-testing or role-play open to interpretation; enforcement relies mainly on the model’s existing ability to terminate chats rather than automatic account bans.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此正式化延伸了先前的模型福利實驗，但「無謂殘忍」與合法壓力測試或角色扮演之間的界線仍有解釋空間；執行主要仰賴模型既有的結束對話能力，而非自動封禁帳號。
items_flat.quote: We’ve added a prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward our models. The policy update is meant to apply only in extreme cases, where users repeatedly act cruelly toward our models, with no discernible purpose.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們新增了禁止對我們的模型進行持續且無謂的虐待或殘忍行為。政策更新僅適用於極端情況，即使用者反覆對我們的模型做出殘忍行為且無明顯目的。

items_flat.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities on medical and scientific research with Muse models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作，以 Muse 模型進行醫學與科學研究
items_flat.summary_en: On October 28 Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State College of Medicine, LSU, Indiana University, and UTHealth Houston, providing $2 million in grants plus access to latest Muse models (including Wonder, Spark Open, and Glimmer) for medical and scientific research under controlled terms.
items_flat.summary_zh: 10月28日 Meta 宣布與 Caltech、俄亥俄州立醫學院、LSU、印第安納大學及 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供200萬美元補助加上最新 Muse 模型（包括 Wonder、Spark Open 與 Glimmer）存取，供受控條款下的醫學與科學研究使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program expands academic access to Meta’s newer closed and open-weight models under controlled terms, particularly useful for domain-specific medical work. Funding is modest relative to the scale of the models and the partnerships are research-focused rather than product deployments.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫在受控條款下擴大學術界對 Meta 較新封閉與開源權重模型的存取，特別有利於領域特定醫學工作。補助相對於模型規模屬適度，合作以研究為主而非產品部署。
items_flat.quote: Meta is bringing Superintelligence models, research funding, and direct researcher collaboration to US universities.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta正將超智慧模型、研究資金與直接研究員協作帶給美國大學。

openai.quote: Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans’ usage allowance will be shared across ChatGPT and Codex as we bring the agentic capabilities of Work into the main ChatGPT experience.
openai.quote_zh: 自十二月起，Plus、Pro 與 Business 方案的使用額度將在 ChatGPT 與 Codex 之間共享，因為我們將把 Work 的代理能力帶入主要 ChatGPT 體驗。

links.label: OpenAI Help Center – Understanding ChatGPT and Codex usage limits

openai.title_en: OpenAI will honor shared robots.txt signal for AI-training preferences
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 將支援共享 robots.txt AI 訓練偏好訊號
openai.summary_en: OpenAI’s October 30 blog post announces it will honor a common robots.txt signal (tied to the IETF AI Preferences work) so website operators can express one preference about foundational generative AI training to multiple participating providers. Implementation is targeted for the coming months; existing crawler controls remain in force and the signal does not replace them.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 10月30日部落格宣布將遵守共通的 robots.txt 訊號（與 IETF AI 偏好工作相關），讓網站營運者能一次向多個參與供應商表達基礎生成式 AI 訓練的偏好。實施目標為未來數月；既有爬蟲控制仍持續有效，新訊號不會取代它們。
openai.analysis_en: The move reduces per-provider rules for publishers but remains voluntary and phased; actual enforcement depends on when each lab finishes implementation and on the still-draft status of the underlying signal.
openai.analysis_zh: 此舉降低出版商需為各供應商分別設定規則的負擔，但仍屬自願且分階段；實際執行取決於各實驗室完成實作的時間，以及底層訊號仍屬草案的狀態。
openai.quote: Today, we’re announcing that OpenAI will honor a common signal in robots.txt... We aim to implement the signal in the coming months... This new signal will not replace the controls we already provide through robots.txt.
openai.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 OpenAI 將遵守 robots.txt 中的共通訊號……我們目標在未來數月內實作該訊號……此新訊號不會取代我們已透過 robots.txt 提供的控制。

links.label: OpenAI Blog – Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic renames Max 20x to Ultra and removes five-hour limit for verified accounts
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Max 20x 更名為 Ultra，並為驗證帳號移除五小時限制
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s help center documents and an October 30 X post state that the $200 Max 20x plan is now called Ultra, with prices unchanged. Verified Ultra accounts no longer face the rolling five-hour usage cap; weekly limits (10× Pro) and other controls remain.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 幫助中心文件與10月30日 X 貼文指出，$200 的 Max 20x 方案現更名為 Ultra，價格不變。已驗證的 Ultra 帳號不再受滾動五小時使用上限限制；每週上限（10× Pro）與其他控制仍保留。
anthropic.analysis_en: Removing the short-cycle cap on the top consumer plan reduces friction for heavy Claude Code users without increasing total weekly allowance, while the verification step adds a light identity gate.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 移除頂層消費方案的短週期上限，降低重度 Claude Code 使用者的摩擦，但未增加總每週額度；驗證步驟則增加輕量身份門檻。
anthropic.quote: We're also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們也為已驗證的 Ultra 帳戶移除5小時限制，今天起從大多數現有訂閱者開始。

links.label: Anthropic on X (Max to Ultra rename)
Claude Help Center: What is the Ultra plan?

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic updates usage policy to ban sustained needless abuse of Claude
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 更新使用政策，禁止對 Claude 持續無謂虐待
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s October 8 usage-policy update (effective November 12) adds a prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward its models. The company states the rule applies only to extreme, purposeless cases and does not cover ordinary frustration, criticism, dark creative themes, or model research; ending the conversation remains the primary enforcement mechanism.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 10月8日的使用政策更新（11月12日生效）新增禁止對其模型進行持續且無謂的虐待或殘忍行為。公司表示該規則僅適用於極端、無目的的情況，不涵蓋一般挫折、批評、黑暗創作主題或模型研究；結束對話仍是主要執行機制。
anthropic.analysis_en: The formalization extends earlier model-welfare experiments but leaves the boundary between “needless cruelty” and legitimate stress-testing or role-play open to interpretation; enforcement relies mainly on the model’s existing ability to terminate chats rather than automatic account bans.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此正式化延伸了先前的模型福利實驗，但「無謂殘忍」與合法壓力測試或角色扮演之間的界線仍有解釋空間；執行主要仰賴模型既有的結束對話能力，而非自動封禁帳號。
anthropic.quote: We’ve added a prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward our models. The policy update is meant to apply only in extreme cases, where users repeatedly act cruelly toward our models, with no discernible purpose.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們新增了禁止對我們的模型進行持續且無謂的虐待或殘忍行為。政策更新僅適用於極端情況，即使用者反覆對我們的模型做出殘忍行為且無明顯目的。

google.title_en: Google receives first AI response from Project Suncatcher prototype satellite TPU
google.title_zh: Google 從 Project Suncatcher 原型衛星 TPU 收到首次 AI 回應
google.summary_en: Google Research’s October 30 post reports that the Project Suncatcher prototype satellite, launched October 1, completed commissioning and returned its first AI output from a data-center-class TPU in orbit. An onboard Gemma 4 model generated a haiku about being in space during a ground-station pass over Svalbard; further thermal and radiation tests are planned ahead of twin-satellite work in 2027.
google.summary_zh: Google Research 10月30日貼文指出，10月1日發射的 Project Suncatcher 原型衛星已完成調校，並從軌道上的資料中心級 TPU 傳回首次 AI 輸出。 onboard 的 Gemma 4 模型在經過斯瓦爾巴地面站時生成了一首關於在太空的俳句；後續將進行熱與輻射測試，為 2027 年雙衛星工作鋪路。
google.analysis_en: The milestone confirms basic on-orbit TPU inference is possible but does not yet demonstrate scalable orbital compute; radiation hardness, power, thermal control and inter-satellite networking remain open engineering questions.
google.analysis_zh: 此里程碑確認軌道上基本 TPU 推理可行，但尚未展示可擴展的軌道計算；輻射耐受、電力、熱控與衛星間網路仍是開放的工程問題。
google.quote: This week, we reached our "Hello World" milestone: the first-ever AI response from a data center class TPU in orbit.
google.quote_zh: 本週，我們達到了「Hello World」里程碑：軌道上資料中心級 TPU 首次傳回 AI 回應。

links.label: Google Blog – Project Suncatcher satellite response

google.title_en: Google DeepMind expands Gemini-powered PlanAssist to 12 more UK councils
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 將 Gemini 驅動的 PlanAssist 擴展至額外12個英國議會
google.summary_en: DeepMind’s October 31 blog post states that PlanAssist, built with Gemini, is moving from three pilot councils into a 12-month beta with 12 additional English local authorities (15 total). Early pilots cut householder application assessment times while retaining human oversight.
google.summary_zh: DeepMind 10月31日部落格指出，以 Gemini 打造的 PlanAssist 正從三個試點議會進入12個月測試，新增12個英格蘭地方當局（共15個）。早期試點縮短了戶主申請評估時間，同時保留人工監督。
google.analysis_en: This is a practical government-deployment story rather than a model release, showing Gemini applied to high-volume administrative work with human oversight retained. The reported time savings are pilot-specific and not yet independently audited at scale.
google.analysis_zh: 這是實用的政府部署故事而非模型釋出，顯示 Gemini 應用於高量行政工作並保留人工監督。報告的時間節省為試點特定，尚未大規模獨立稽核。
google.quote: PlanAssist has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%.
google.quote_zh: PlanAssist 已顯示能將規劃官員評估屋主申請的時間最多減少58%。

meta.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities on medical and scientific research with Muse models
meta.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作，以 Muse 模型進行醫學與科學研究
meta.summary_en: On October 28 Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State College of Medicine, LSU, Indiana University, and UTHealth Houston, providing $2 million in grants plus access to latest Muse models (including Wonder, Spark Open, and Glimmer) for medical and scientific research under controlled terms.
meta.summary_zh: 10月28日 Meta 宣布與 Caltech、俄亥俄州立醫學院、LSU、印第安納大學及 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供200萬美元補助加上最新 Muse 模型（包括 Wonder、Spark Open 與 Glimmer）存取，供受控條款下的醫學與科學研究使用。
meta.analysis_en: The program expands academic access to Meta’s newer closed and open-weight models under controlled terms, particularly useful for domain-specific medical work. Funding is modest relative to the scale of the models and the partnerships are research-focused rather than product deployments.
meta.analysis_zh: 此計畫在受控條款下擴大學術界對 Meta 較新封閉與開源權重模型的存取，特別有利於領域特定醫學工作。補助相對於模型規模屬適度，合作以研究為主而非產品部署。
meta.quote: Meta is bringing Superintelligence models, research funding, and direct researcher collaboration to US universities.
meta.quote_zh: Meta正將超智慧模型、研究資金與直接研究員協作帶給美國大學。

xai.title_en: Musk details Colossus 2 expansion with Gun Range and Spam halls targeting ~1.2M Blackwells
xai.title_zh: Musk 詳述 Colossus 2 擴建，新增 Gun Range 與 Spam 大廳，目標年底約120萬 Blackwell
xai.summary_en: In X posts on October 31, Elon Musk stated that Macroharder and Minihard each hold 220,000 Nvidia GB300s for training; a former police gun range (“Gun Range”) will match that setup and is tracking for end-of-November operation, while a former Hormel building (“Spam”) will hold ~200,000 GB300s for inference in December. He said the campus is expected to reach around 1.2 million Blackwells by year-end.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk 10月31日在 X 發文指出，Macroharder 與 Minihard 各有 22 萬顆 Nvidia GB300 用於訓練；前警察局靶場（Gun Range）將配置相同規模並目標於十一月底運作，前 Hormel 建築（Spam）則將於十二月配置約 20 萬顆 GB300 用於推理。他表示園區年底預計達約 120 萬顆 Blackwell。
xai.analysis_en: The figures are Musk’s own targets rather than independently verified inventory; they expand the power and permitting footprint already under legal challenge while accelerating the compute ramp for Grok training and inference.
xai.analysis_zh: 這些數字為 Musk 個人目標而非獨立驗證的庫存；它們擴大了已面臨法律挑戰的電力與許可足跡，同時加速 Grok 訓練與推理的算力擴張。
xai.quote: Gun Range is tracking to be operational by end of November and Spam in December. ... the campus would have around 1.2 million Blackwells by year-end.
xai.quote_zh: Gun Range 目標於十一月底運作，Spam 則在十二月。……園區年底預計有約 120 萬顆 Blackwell。

links.label: Elon Musk on X (via contemporaneous reports)

xai.title_en: xAI/SpaceXSI to enable default invisible text watermarks on Grok API from November 7
xai.title_zh: xAI/SpaceXSI 自11月7日起對 Grok API 預設啟用不可見文字浮水印
xai.summary_en: SpaceXSI developer documentation states that starting November 7, 2026, text outputs from grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-4.3 and three grok-4.20 variants will carry an invisible statistical watermark by default on both Responses and Chat Completions endpoints.
xai.summary_zh: SpaceXSI 開發者文件指出，自2026年11月7日起，grok-4.7、grok-4.6、grok-4.5、grok-4.3 及三個 grok-4.20 變體的文字輸出將在 Responses 與 Chat Completions 端點預設帶有不可見統計浮水印。
xai.analysis_en: The watermark is a compliance mechanism that slightly shapes token selection without adding visible characters or changing length/speed claims. It affects API customers only for now and does not alter consumer Grok surfaces.
xai.analysis_zh: 浮水印是合規機制，輕微影響 token 選擇，但不增加可見字元或改變長度／速度宣稱。目前僅影響 API 客戶，不改變消費者 Grok 介面。
xai.quote: Starting November 7, 2026, responses from these models include a watermark. It's on by default, and you can opt out per model.
xai.quote_zh: 自2026年11月7日起，這些模型的回應將包含浮水印。預設開啟，您可按模型退出。

links.label: SpaceXSI / xAI Developer Docs – Output Watermarking

xai.title_en: Judge denies xAI motion to dismiss NAACP Clean Air Act suit over Southaven turbines
xai.title_zh: 法官駁回 xAI 請求駁回 NAACP 針對 Southaven 渦輪機的清潔空氣法訴訟
xai.summary_en: On or around October 30, U.S. District Judge Debra M. Brown denied xAI’s motion to dismiss the NAACP’s Clean Air Act lawsuit concerning gas turbines powering the Colossus data center in Southaven, Mississippi. The court found the turbines are subject to permitting requirements and allowed the claims to proceed.
xai.summary_zh: 約10月30日，美國地區法官 Debra M. Brown 駁回 xAI 請求駁回 NAACP 針對密西西比 Southaven Colossus 資料中心燃氣渦輪機的清潔空氣法訴訟。法院認定渦輪機受許可要求拘束，並允許訴訟繼續。
xai.analysis_en: The ruling keeps the permitting and emissions claims alive but does not decide liability. It is an operational and regulatory risk story for xAI’s power infrastructure rather than a model or product announcement.
xai.analysis_zh: 裁決讓許可與排放主張繼續進行，但未裁定責任。這是 xAI 電力基礎設施的營運與監管風險故事，而非模型或產品公告。
xai.quote: Because the Plant is not a ‘mobile source’ according to the federal regulations…the Plant was not (and is not) exempted from permitting requirements under the Clean Air Act.
xai.quote_zh: 根據聯邦法規，該廠並非『移動來源』……該廠過去（及現在）並未豁免清潔空氣法下的許可要求。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 釋出約1兆參數 Large 4 開源權重
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a multimodal MoE model with roughly 1 trillion total parameters (about 52 billion active), on or around October 29 under its ecosystem open-weight license on Hugging Face. The company also offers it via its API and partners, highlighting coding-agent and cybersecurity use cases after additional reinforcement learning.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 於約10月29日在 Hugging Face 以生態系統開源權重授權釋出 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）的權重，這是約1兆總參數（約520億活躍）的多模態 MoE 模型。公司亦透過自有 API 與合作夥伴提供，並強調經額外強化學習後的程式代理與網路安全用途。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is the largest recent open-weight frontier-class release, improving access for organizations that prefer self-hosting. Reported benchmark gains are company-sourced and still trail the strongest closed models on several agentic coding tests.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是近期最大的開源權重前沿級釋出，提升偏好自託管組織的存取能力。報告的基準提升來自公司來源，在多項代理程式測試上仍落後最強封閉模型。
frontier_other.quote: We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 我們釋出 Le Chonk 的權重，推動開源模型在代理式編碼與網路安全上的前沿。

links.label: Coverage of Mistral Large 4 open-weights release

brief_en: OpenAI will pool ChatGPT and Codex usage into one token allowance from December (Instant exempt) and will honor a shared robots.txt AI-training preference. Anthropic’s updated usage policy bans sustained needless abuse of Claude (effective Nov 12). xAI targets ~1.2M Blackwells at Colossus 2 with new halls; Google received the first AI response from its Project Suncatcher satellite TPU. Prior October model and partnership stories remain in force.
brief_zh: OpenAI 自十二月起將 ChatGPT 與 Codex 使用額度合併為單一 token 池（Instant 除外），並支援共享 robots.txt AI 訓練偏好訊號。Anthropic 更新使用政策禁止對 Claude 持續無謂虐待（11月12日生效）。xAI 目標 Colossus 2 年底達約120萬 Blackwell，Google 衛星 TPU 首次傳回 AI 回應。先前十月模型與合作動態仍有效。
